## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Session Report
where: RinkService (uses), src/business/rinkService.ts, component business

response.rationale: These are different concepts. A is a report that RinkService produces: getReport takes a date range ("from", "to", "weekStart") and returns a Report, so it is a summary built over many items. B is the Session entity itself, held as individual records in InMemorySessionRepository's Map<string, Session>. A report about sessions is a derived summary, not the same real-world thing as one session. Sharing the word "Session" in the concept name is not enough to make them the same. Confidence is not full because I can't see the definitions of Report or Session.
